fullPassage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.

A Flounder Smarter Than Any Fish (어떤 물고기보다 똑똑한 넙치)
A Master of Disguise Beneath the Waves (파도 아래 위장의 달인)

questions.passage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to <u>turn itself into a completely different creature</u>. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 turn itself into a completely different creature이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '스스로를 완전히 다른 생물로 바꾼다' = 위장 능력으로 다른 생물처럼 보이게 만든다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 유전적으로 변함: 문어는 실제로 종이 바뀌는 것이 아니라 겉모습을 위장함

✅ ② 다른 생물처럼 보이게 만듦: 색·무늬를 바꾸고 자세를 취해 넙치나 바다뱀처럼 보이게 한다는 뜻 ←정답

❌ ③ 잡아먹어 흡수: 밑줄은 섭취가 아닌 외형 위장을 뜻함

❌ ④ 크기를 두 배로: 본문은 크기 변화가 아닌 색·무늬·자세를 통한 위장을 말함
det.tip: turn itself into a different creature = 다른 생물처럼 보이게 위장

det.korean: this one = 그들이 다시 보고 발견한 중간 크기의 문어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: '바다뱀으로 변신하는(transforming into sea snakes)' — 추가로 관찰된 모방 사례
det.analysis:

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 (영어로) 쓰시오.

그들이 처음에 본 것은 넙치였다
[조건] (1) a, at, first, flounder, saw, they, was, what 를 모두 사용 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '그들이 본 것'은 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절로 쓰고, 단수 취급해 동사 was를 쓴다
det.analysis:
'그들이 처음에 본 것'은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 명사절 'what they saw at first'이다.

→ 이 명사절이 주어이고 단수 취급하므로 동사는 was이다.

→ 완성: what they saw at first was a flounder (8단어)
det.tip: what + 주어 + 동사 = ~하는 것 (명사절, 단수 취급)

questions.wa: what they saw at first was a flounder
accept: what they saw at first was a flounder

questions.passage: It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms __________ (fold) and its two eyes staring upwards.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: fold → folded: 'with + 명사 + 과거분사' 구문으로, 팔이 '접힌' 수동 관계
det.analysis: 'with all eight of its arms __________ (fold)'는 'with + 명사 + 분사' 부대상황 구문이다. 팔(arms)이 '접힌' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 folded가 필요하다. fold → folded
det.tip: with + 명사 + 과거분사 = ~이 …된 채로. with its arms folded

여덟 개의 팔을 모두 접은 채로

→ 완성: with all eight of its arms folded (7단어)
det.tip: with + 명사 + 과거분사 = ~이 …된 채로

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (영어로)

[ best / defence / have / most / octopus / of / species / the ] (8단어)

det.korean: '대부분의 문어 종이 가진 최선의 방어'를 목적격 관계대명사가 생략된 형태로 배열한다
det.analysis:
핵심 명사구는 the best defence(최선의 방어)이다.

→ 뒤에 'most species of octopus have'(대부분의 문어 종이 가진)가 목적격 관계대명사 생략으로 수식한다.

→ 완성: the best defence most species of octopus have
det.tip: the best defence (which) most species of octopus have = 대부분의 문어 종이 가진 최선의 방어

이 문어는 이러한 능력들을 사용하고 있었다
[조건] (1) assets, one, these, this, using, was 를 모두 사용 (2) 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '사용하고 있었다'는 과거진행형 was using으로 쓴다

det.tip: was + V-ing = 과거진행형. was using these assets
